shortDescription: Add or remove an apt key

options.name: data
options.description: The keyfile contents to add to the keyring.

options.name: file
options.description: The path to a keyfile on the remote server to add to the keyring.

options.name: id
options.description: The identifier of the key. Including this allows check mode to correctly report the changed state. If specifying a subkey's id be aware that apt-key does not understand how to remove keys via a subkey id. Specify the primary key's id instead. This parameter is required when O(state) is set to V(absent).

options.name: keyring
options.description: The full path to specific keyring file in C(/etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/).

options.name: keyserver
options.description: The keyserver to retrieve key from.

options.name: state
options.description: Ensures that the key is present (added) or absent (revoked).

options.name: url
options.description: The URL to retrieve key from.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates for the target url will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
